Hi Rohan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency and cost profile were helpful. We are reviewing packaging for our upcoming pilot and have two open questions before procurement will sign off:

1) Upgrade/downgrade window: we need a clear policy for moving between the compact (seat-focused) and throughput tiers mid-term. If usage spikes in January, how quickly can we move to a throughput-focused plan and what prorations apply?

2) Seat-to-throughput exchange: is there a one-time credit or conversion rate you support if we trade N seats for a reserved throughput bucket? We want to avoid double-paying during the first 90 days.

Can you share a short sketch of options and any example pricing? I can loop in our procurement lead if this looks reasonable.

Best,

Hi Maria — great questions. Looping Ben (pricing lead) and Priya (AM) so we can provide both the commercial options and a clear implementation path. High level answers below; I'll attach a one-page pricing grid and a draft SOW for context.

Short answers:
- Upgrade/downgrade window: we support same-day tier moves for Hosted plans, but reserved throughput (Dedicated) requires a 7-14 day provisioning window if new capacity needs to be reserved. Proration: monthly prorate based on days in each tier; for annual committed contracts we offer a one-time grace credit for the first upgrade within the first 90 days.
- Seat-to-throughput exchange: we can offer a conversion credit formula: credits = seats * seat_token_equivalent, where the seat_token_equivalent depends on model mix. For simplicity we typically propose a conservative 1 seat -> 0.7 throughput-credit baseline for the first conversion, with a bonus credit if you commit to a 6-month minimum on the throughput bucket.

Actionable next steps I propose:
1) Quick 30-minute pricing workshop with Priya + Ben + your procurement to align on usage shape (we'll bring our cost model).
2) Post-workshop we issue two paths: (A) Hosted upgrade path with immediate effect + monthly prorate and a 90-day one-time grace credit, or (B) Dedicated path with provisioning timeline and a conversion credit schedule.

I attached: HealthGrid_pricing_grid_v2.xlsx and HealthGrid_SOW_draft.pdf (pricing grid shows the sample conversion math).

Would Thursday 11/18 10am PT for the workshop work for you?

Cheers,

Maria — quick note on the conversion mechanics from pricing perspective:

- We treat the first conversion as a promotional conversion (higher bonus credit) if HealthGrid commits to a 6-month throughput minimum OR signs up for our Dedicated pilot. That avoids the double-pay period you mentioned.
- If you prefer flexibility, the Hosted immediate-upgrade path is simplest: no provisioning delay, prorated billing, and we apply a one-time usage credit equal to 15% of the incremental spend during the first 30 days.

I'll bring a worked example to the workshop (I checked the pilot_requirements you attached earlier). If you can share last-90d token usage by model (rough buckets: chat-heavy vs embedding-heavy) we can give a tighter conversion factor.

Thanks — Ben
